current.text: Jackson is eligible for a contract extension but has not been extended.

He is projected to come off the bench. The projected starters are Ty Jerome, Cedric Coward, Jerami Grant, Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey. He is in the bench group with Pippen, Wells, Stewart and Cam Spencer.
Too many players are ahead of him for him to have real fantasy value.
The Memphis forward group is crowded, and the team still has more players than roster spots.
Memphis is expected to use an 11 or 12 man rotation. Only Cameron Boozer and Cedric Coward are expected to top 30 minutes.
Memphis has three first-round picks in the 2027 draft. That gives it room to make trades, possibly including Jerami Grant.
Memphis has a 4-4-4 schedule in our playoff weeks through March 28. It has only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: He is an empty scorer. He adds little outside of points.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo plays at a very high pace. He uses short, hard stints of about five minutes and keeps minutes down.

note: Yahoo ranks him 221 and ESPN ranks him 193, with a value of 0 USD on both. He was not drafted in our league last season. In a 144-player auction he should go undrafted. The projections disagree on his efficiency: Yahoo projects 44.8% FG with 2.1 TO, and ESPN projects 48.4% FG with 1.6 TO. Neither projection gives him a strong category, and no build especially needs him. Early in the season, watch two things: whether he wins small forward minutes off the bench, and whether a Jerami Grant trade opens a role for him. Only then is he worth a waiver claim.
